name: Ormoc customs building
blurb: A plain port customs house, with no light.
history: A Japanese Notice to Mariners records a customs building with a fixed red light at the port of Ormoc. Only its existence is sourced: its appearance and whether it survived to 1944 are not, so every part of this one-story house, with its gable roof, porch and shuttered windows, is an estimate. The light is deliberately left out; this model has no lamp.

sources.title: Notice to Mariners (JACAR, Japan Center for Asian Historical Records)
